accepted_scope: On the saturated unit-weight U(3,4) fan, for A>=0,B>0,C>B real and rational epsilon>0, reference Gamma=Aeta+Bh has explicit strict local supports in the disclosed active-coefficient convention and positive recession slopes; its exact all-competitor envelope P=Gamma+Bu_epsilon is finite real PA on a rational structure, with raw masses4(A+B)^2 and twice B(4A+3B), degree4A^2+16AB+10B^2, contact integral-4(C-B)epsilon(A+B)^2. Integral parameters give literal integral-slope/rational-constant endpoints and the literal raw finite operator. Separate obstacles v_n for Gamma=h have exact nonintegral envelopes Q_n and uniform literal approximation gap>=1/(4n). No general real operator extension or all-obstacle pair regularity is assumed.
residual_original_scope: General necessary-and-sufficient structural characterization of all balanced pairs and admissible obstacles remains open. All-obstacle real regularity on this fan and stronger unspecified smoothness hypotheses are not proved or disproved. The simplest literal pair is nonregular, while its selected main endpoint has a valid raw measure.
